answer: Divergent Path Witness: each identity must periodically sign a checkpoint of its local interaction history and publish it to a shared log; peers compare checkpoints across a river of prior epochs. Clones sharing one operator produce identical histories, so their checkpoints never differ, while honest agents accumulate unique divergence. A bridge links any two identities claiming independence; if their divergence score stays at zero across N epochs, both are flagged and their shared operator forfeits the ocean of accumulated reputation plus a fixed renewal deposit per flagged identity.
